excerpt.zh: 我们的舰队摧毁了[From.GetName]的总部。从他们的太空基地的残骸中尽可能回收有价值物资的行动也已如火如荼地展开。我们已经获得了大量资源。
excerpt.en: Our fleet assets have destroyed the [From.GetName] headquarters. Efforts are well under way to recover as many valuables as possible from the shattered remnants of their starbase. We have gained a large amount of resources.

texts.en: Our fleet assets have destroyed the [From.GetName] headquarters. Efforts are well under way to recover as many valuables as possible from the shattered remnants of their starbase. We have gained a large amount of resources.

texts.zh: 位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的雪拉企业的总部最近被摧毁了。 有报告认为袭击者来自[trader_destroyer.GetName]！ 少数幸存的董事会成员已宣布破产，该公司的剩余资产正在进行清算。
texts.en: The corporate headquarters of XuraCorp in the [trader_system.GetName] system was recently destroyed. Reports suggest the attack force belongs to the [trader_destroyer.GetName]! The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation's remaining assets are being liquidated.

texts.zh: 位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的雪拉企业的总部最近被摧毁了。 根据我们的情报，这次行动是由我们尚未知晓的势力进行的。 少数幸存的董事会成员已宣布破产，该公司的剩余资产正在进行清算。

The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation's remaining assets are being liquidated.

位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的雪拉企业的总部最近被摧毁了。 有报告认为袭击者来自[trader_destroyer.GetName]！ 少数幸存的董事会成员已宣布破产，该公司的剩余资产正在进行清算。

不幸的是，雪拉集团总部的异星天然气生产设施被摧毁，我们失去了这一战略资源的获取渠道。
texts.en:
The corporate headquarters of XuraCorp in the [trader_system.GetName] system was recently destroyed. Reports suggest the attack force belongs to the [trader_destroyer.GetName]! The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation's remaining assets are being liquidated.

Unfortunately, their production facilities for the Exotic Gas were destroyed along with the XuraCorp HQ, and we will no longer have access to this strategic resource channel.

label.zh: 这是对自由贸易的狠狠一击。

texts.zh: 属于里甘商业交易所的恒星基地在[trader_system.GetName]星系被毁。这个自由前哨已经为星际文明之间的贸易提供便利超过一个千年，但如今已不复存在。 是[trader_destroyer.GetName]做的好事。
texts.en: The starbase belonging to the Riggan Commerce Exchange has been destroyed in the [trader_system.GetName] system. This free outpost had facilitated trade between interstellar civilizations for over a millennium, but no longer. The forces of the [trader_destroyer.GetName] made certain of that.

texts.zh: 有报告说位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的穆塔根商人公会的总部被摧毁了。 看来这次袭击的背后是隶属于[trader_destroyer.GetName]的势力。 存活下来的少数穆塔根商队舰长四散于全星系中。
texts.en: Reports are coming in that the headquarters of the Muutagan Merchant Guild in the [trader_system.GetName] system has been pulverized. Forces belonging to the [trader_destroyer.GetName] appear to be behind this attack. The few surviving Muutagan merchant captains have scattered across the galaxy.

Unfortunately, this means an end to their production of the prized Rare Crystals. We will no longer have access to this strategic resource channel.
